title: Exiting, quiet and safe morning sailing
text: This has been a great and unforgettable experience on board a clean and well sailed boat. Marian has been the sailboat Master and she was really professional. Nice, beatiful, safe and optimal trip. Totally recommended.
author: Sergi971

title: Captain spaghetti 😅😂
text: We have had a nice experience with captain spaghetti (marcelo) blissful person and very professional definitely worth it
author: Melrenlabajo

title: A MUST IF YOU ARE IN BARCELONA
text: DON’T MISS IT!! Amazing experience enjoyed with my husband and my 6y boy. Beautiful sailing boat, very well maintained and secure. Lovely sunny day and despite the strong wind our skipper Fabio managed the boat very well…good job! We saw Barcelona from different points of view, but from the sea was definitely the best one!My son was very excited and he enjoyed the tour very much.. as I did! Absolutely recommended!
author: 523mauriziod

title: Different Sunset and Good Mood
text: Fantastic experience in which we saw our city from another angle. We had fun, learned a lot of things and enjoyed a different sunset. Vicky took us fantastically well and answered all our questions. A crack.
author: Txeeeeell

title: The best experience in the Balearic Sea Waters
text: Apart from the beautiful views of Barcelona from the sea , nice boat and an attention of Patron Mariam. Excellent, I hope to be back soon.
author: gabrieldorrego1

title: Awesome Experience
text: Thank you Jorge for an amazing time. We booked the trip Noon Erik early mornings at of the trip (we were worried about the weather). After some slight booking troubles, the team was more than accommodative for giving us a perfect sailing experience and some relaxation out of the city craziness.  Highly recommend and highly professional.
author: Brian D

title: Best sailing experience in Barcelone
text:
Vicky was beyond amazing and made us feel like friends rather than customers. We enjoyed speaking a few different languages with her and other people with us on the boat. It felt great having a glass of wine while speaking of our respective native countries. She allowed us to take a swim which also felt great. I highly recommend Vicky and we hope to see her again one day :) 
Alexandra and Modibo

title: Starting summer with sunshine sea and vermouth

title: Fantastic Barcelona from a different perspective!
text: This os a fantastic activity from the beginning to the end! Our Skipper was Nora and she was amazing, she explained some of the key points pf the city and was always available to answer our questions, also she made us a great brunch! The view of the city from the see is unique and a must see. We could even sail the boat for a while! I strongly recommend it!
